frontend.note: Complete. All 33 screens the enumerator names plus 7 states of them, across 19 tests in 6 specs, each with a full-page shot, a page model and the rendered DOM. The sha is the last commit that touched src, not HEAD: naming the directory after HEAD orphaned every picture each time the capture harness itself was edited, and those pixels were identical. The states exist because findings needed them, and one of them is the only picture of an actual defect in the corpus: fe-hub-exit-details-blocked shows the Exit details row present, unlinked, and reading 'Cannot start yet' under a reason for which port of exit was already answered.

prototype.note: Complete. 42 screens across six specs — all 23 pages DR1 has, plus 19 states of them. Coverage reports nothing missing and nothing unexplained. The last two states were added once findings needed them: dr1-roles-and-addresses-partial is the only state in which DR1 renders its Same-as address shortcuts, and dr1-review-notification-incomplete the only one showing the per-card error state a user meets when they open review early.
